contract.timed_metric: complete resident Product5 cycle after excluding the identical host-to-resident reset
contract.candidate_route: tile only the first transition at 2^25 elements and use the retained transition for the remaining eight Metal rounds
contract.transient_evaluator: JOLT_METAL_EVAL_LOG_N=25 JOLT_METAL_EVAL_REPEATS=10 JOLT_METAL_EVAL_SEED=1 JOLT_METAL_TRANSITION_STRATEGY=paired cargo run --release -p jolt-kernels --features metal,akita,test-utils --example metal-kernel-eval -- instruction-read-raf-cycle

prior_standalone_screen.interpretation: The isolated transition cleared the three-percent mechanism gate, so sequence integration was warranted but not yet promotable.

small_scale_control.interpretation: Tiled transitions are not a general replacement for the retained kernel.

correctness.standalone_biguint_test: cargo nextest run -p jolt-kernels product5_tiled_transition_matches_biguint --cargo-quiet --features test-utils,akita,metal

decision.reason: The isolated kernel reduces its own active and wall time, but the complete resident sequence gains only 3.1 percent GPU-active time and regresses the primary direct-handoff wall in both position strata. The primary metric therefore falsifies production integration.
decision.next_action: Keep the retained Product5 sequence unchanged. Reconsider the tiled primitive only inside an architecture that removes its additional dispatch and completion exposure, and require a paired complete-sequence win before integration.
